obstacle_departure_procedures.content: KACY entry lists only TAKEOFF OBSTACLE NOTES (no non-standard takeoff minimums and no named ODP climb gradient text in the entry). Obstacle notes (verbatim summary): Rwy 4 sign 36 ft from DER 303 ft right 4 ft AGL/69 MSL; trees up to 135 MSL (1942-2583 ft from DER). Rwy 13 NAVAID 42 ft from DER 149 ft right 2 AGL/65 MSL; trees up to 118 MSL. Rwy 22 terrain and NAVAID from 5 ft from DER up to 63 MSL; poles/transmission tower up to 90 MSL; trees up to 126 MSL. Rwy 31 light support structures 10-11 ft from DER 2 AGL/76-77 MSL; trees beginning 2405 ft from DER up to 144 MSL. Full list in the PDF.
obstacle_departure_procedures.note: Shared regional PDF (all NE-2 airports), not KACY-specific.

stars_note: No STAR for KACY in the d-TPP metadata (no STAR records under KACY) and no ACY rows in NASR STAR_APT/DP_APT. NASR FRQ shows the ACY approach facility (124.6/327.125) is listed for "WAALK STAR" serving MJX (McGuire), not KACY.
sids_note: No SID records for KACY (the Atlantic City Three Departure above is the only departure chart).
